related_resources.reason: Sections 3A–3B: nonnegative integral, monotone convergence, signed integration, and warning examples.
Lectures 2–5: simple-function integral, monotone convergence, Fatou, signed and dominated convergence.
Alternative construction by increasing simple approximants and limit theorems.
Beppo Levi theorem: increasing nonnegative functions, integral-limit exchange.

description: Constructs the Lebesgue integral from nonnegative simple functions, proves monotone convergence and Fatou’s lemma, analyzes failures of naive limit exchange, and defines signed integration through positive and negative parts.
